changelog:
v1.28.0 - **Playtest pass — combat fixes, power/HUD upgrades, config-driven cleanup, new music (v1.28.0).** **Balance:** the *rider*'s scooter charge now applies a 50% slow + ~2 m knockback instead of a stun, deals 15% less damage, and spawns less often; the *vecchina mattarello* hits 15% softer; and **every enemy stun is now a slow** (controllore, bullo, cane, guardia, plus the bullo soundwave) so a surrounded melee player is never frozen in place. **Tornado di Lame fixed:** the evolved whip swung a tiny 1 m / 30° wedge with 0.05 s sweeps (atk_rate 10) and whiffed — it now swings a real 360° / 3.5 m tornado at atk_rate 5. **Gelo (melee)** became a player-following *ice nova* aura (freezes, slows and damages around you as you move) instead of a thrown grenade; ranged Gelo still lobs the grenade and every Gelo level-up applies to both affinities. **Sballo Totale** now triggers its full-screen chromatic-split VFX when cast as a power (previously wired only to the limit-break card). **HUD:** each power slot shows an **active-effect countdown** as a border progress bar distinct from the radial cooldown; active status effects render as **emoji-only colored tags** (bottom-right) with a radial expiry ring, and clicking them opens a paused details popup listing every effect and its sources. **Architecture:** removed the silent `contact_damage` fallback — every enemy must now declare an explicit `weapon` (validated at load with a clear error) and *modella* was rearmed accordingly; all attack windups are config-driven (the cane's previously hard-coded Poo Mine / Pee Puddle attacks moved into the config). **Audio:** new *musica leggera* lvl 1 & lvl 3 tracks. Verified: clean headless import, project compile, and boot.
v1.27.0 - **Game-feel SFX pass.** Filled in the missing movement/feedback sounds and added a per-shot volume system: `SoundManager.play_sfx(name, channel, volume_db)` takes a per-shot dB offset so a sound can be a subtle "background filler". New: player & enemy **footsteps** (two alternating samples each, cadence scales with speed; enemy steps are distance-attenuated and a touch quieter than the player so your own movement reads clearly); a **dodge-roll** whoosh; the previously-unused `player_hit` **voice** now plays — but only on real HP loss (dodges/shield-absorbed hits are silent), throttled; **per-enemy pain/death cries** routed through a shared helper that distance-attenuates AND de-duplicates by sound name (a simultaneous AoE wipe plays each cry once, not dozens) — the two vecchine + Modella get dedicated on-hit/on-death voices, dogs whimper on hit and whine on death, and every other enemy shares a death scream; **Sballato** cackles on entering its dance; throttled **XP/coin pickup** blips; and a **level-up** fanfare (the HUD already called it — only the asset was missing). Footstep audio is CC-BY 3.0 (congusbongus) — see `assets/sounds/CREDITS.md`; all levels are tunable constants. Verified: clean headless `--import` + `test_balance`/`test_powers`/`test_all_weapons` pass.
v1.26.1 - **New "Rissa" brawler power + weapon/power tuning.** Adds the **Rissa** active power: a temporary, player-centered aura (`BrawlerAura`, an `AreaEffectTicker`, instanced via preload-const to avoid the 4.7 global-class race) that damages and slows nearby enemies — a Vampire-Survivors "Garlic"-style safety bubble for melee builds — with melee/ranged affinity (melee burns nearby foes, ranged widens the slow field) and a full skill-tree (`wide`/`fists`/`circle`/`beatdown`/`throng`/`streetfury`/`tornado`/`massacre`). Bundles the accompanying `powers_config`/`weapons_config`, `WeaponSystem`/`PhysicalMelee`/`PowerState`/`WeaponConfig`/`HUD` changes and extended `test_balance`/`test_powers` coverage.
